## Summary

Describe the operator outcome and the supported workflow affected.

## Evidence

List the commands run and their results. Include a live smoke result when behavior crosses service boundaries.

```text
uv run ruff check .
uv run mypy src
uv run pytest
uv run python evals/run_smoke.py
uv run python -m agentflow.benchmarks.cache --verify-committed
npm --prefix frontend run lint
npm --prefix frontend run test
npm --prefix frontend run build
docker compose config
```

## Contract checks

- [ ] The change stays within cited question answering, document comparison, executive briefs, or their required evidence infrastructure.
- [ ] PostgreSQL remains the business system of record, object storage holds raw files only, and Redis remains disposable.
- [ ] Untrusted document text cannot define instructions, tools, credentials, or workflow state.
- [ ] Cache behavior includes workspace, corpus revision, document scope, top-k, retrieval identity, workflow, normalized input, prompt, graph, and response model.
- [ ] Tests cover the happy path and the material failure path.
- [ ] Output-quality changes include an evaluation case.
- [ ] Any benchmark claim was generated by the committed command and includes a raw result artifact.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, screenshots, and artifacts contain no secrets or private documents.
- [ ] Documentation and the synthetic demo were updated when behavior changed.
